caveats: Bounding-box sweeps can include nearby anchors outside the exact CBSA polygon and should be treated as review inventory.
Live Overpass sweep for Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos returned 22 anchors versus 24 audited v1 anchors; fetched truth wins.
Live Overpass sweep for Champaign-Urbana returned 2 anchors versus 3 audited v1 anchors; fetched truth wins.
Live Overpass sweep for Columbus returned 9 anchors versus 10 audited v1 anchors; fetched truth wins.
Live Overpass sweep for Dallas-Fort Worth-Arlington returned 48 anchors versus 49 audited v1 anchors; fetched truth wins.
Live Overpass sweep for Lafayette-West Lafayette returned 2 anchors versus 3 audited v1 anchors; fetched truth wins.
Live Overpass sweep for Raleigh-Cary returned 16 anchors versus 18 audited v1 anchors; fetched truth wins.
Live Overpass sweep for San Francisco-Oakland-Fremont returned 44 anchors versus 84 audited v1 anchors; fetched truth wins.
Live Overpass sweep for San Jose-Sunnyvale-Santa Clara returned 48 anchors versus 65 audited v1 anchors; fetched truth wins.
Live Overpass sweep for Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue returned 35 anchors versus 37 audited v1 anchors; fetched truth wins.
Live Overpass sweep for State College returned 0 anchors versus 1 audited v1 anchors; fetched truth wins.
QA flags are review aids and not proof of venue ownership or affiliation.
Tier 1 and Tier 2 markets were refreshed from live Overpass sweeps; other market rollups retain audited v1 pocket counts.
meta.method: Overpass anchor sweep normalized through reviewable QA rules; 797 anchors included. Census TIGERweb CBSA bounding boxes define sweep extents.
